cell_Ah_typ.basis: datasheet Molicel INR-21700-P60B (6000 mAh typ, 5850 min)

cell_V_nom.basis: datasheet (Gate A rounds the pack to 370 V = 3.7 V/cell)

cell_V_min.basis: datasheet charge/discharge cut-off 2.5 V (cycle test window); table says 1.8 V absolute

cell_I_chg_max_A.basis: datasheet maximum charge 30 A (70 C cut-off); 5C

R_interconnect_mohm.basis: estimate: busbars + wire bonds for 100 series links (prior design: 5.2 mohm for 99 links)

R_external_mohm.basis: estimate: MSD fuse 0.4 + pyro 0.1 + 2 contactors 0.8 + shunt 0.1 + 2 m of 50 mm2 0.75 + lugs

gx14_carry_A.basis: supplier Gigavac GX14 datasheet: 350+ A, 12-800 V, 0.5 kg

main_fuse_A.basis: design choice: EV fuse 400 A / >=500 VDC in the service plug (rating to confirm on real fuse curve)

pyro_break_kA.basis: supplier Sensata STP500P class (prior study); 500 A, 22 kA break at 500 V

dc_link_uF.basis: prior study: 650 uF CM200 + 65 uF estimates for charger, DC-DC, Y-caps

modules.note: 10 series modules; module-to-module links are the only bolted high-current joints

motor_match.choice: EMRAX 228 LV+43% (360 V for peak power), liquid or combined cooled
motor_match.why: pack is 250-420 V (loaded floor about 330 V at 10% SOC under peak). MV needs 630 V and HV 830 V, so they cannot reach peak power on this bus (same conclusion as drive-study.md). LV+43% needs 360 V and 650 Arms.
motor_match.inverter_H100_150A_cont: FAILS: 150 Arms continuous gives 51 Nm, i.e. 29 kW at 5500 rpm (<55 kW target); 450 A peak gives 88 kW
motor_match.inverter_CM200DX_300A_cont_740A_peak: PASSES: 300 Arms continuous gives 58 kW at 5500 rpm; 740 A peak > 650 A motor peak
motor_match.verdict: Cascadia CM200DX (6.75 kg, 50-480 V, 300 Arms cont / 740 Arms peak) is the inverter. The emDrive H100 (3.5 kg) cannot supply this motor's current.

short_circuit.GX14_make_break_note: contactor opens only below about 350 A; all higher currents are cleared by pyro or fuse
short_circuit.peak_vs_fuse: DC current is capped at 350 A in VCU/inverter (matches GX14 carry); 350 A is 0.88 x the 400 A fuse (below the usual 1.3 x no-blow)
short_circuit.continuous_vs_fuse_derated: worst continuous 55 kW at 10% SOC is about 187 A against 0.8 x 400 = 320 A
pyro_trip_rules: crash flag (IMU / ABS unit) within 20 ms

rules: steady rise <= 40 K at 31.8 A per-cell peak
cell_fuse_wire.decision: YES, per-cell fusing: one Al wire bond (about 0.40 mm) per cell end, 2,200 bonds. Wire diameter to be settled by pulse and fusing tests, not by this model.
cell_fuse_wire.caveat: adiabatic model: conservative for neighbours surviving, optimistic for opening speed. Cell resistance is the datasheet value; weld/bond resistance is an estimate.

precharge.rule: close main + contactor when bus >= pack - 21 V; if not within 0.5 s abort and latch fault; weld-check precharge relay
precharge.active_discharge: bus must fall below 60 V within 3 s of contactor opening (inverter active discharge; to be specified with Cascadia). Passive 70 kohm bleed alone is 88 s.

isolation.monitor: Bender ISOMETER iso175C class (or IR155-class automotive IMD) on the HV bus; BMS isolation check as cross-check
isolation.why_210: the OBC makes the bus conductively linked to an AC circuit while plugged in, so the stricter 500 ohm/V figure (210 kohm at 420 V) is used in all modes
isolation.dc_charge_note: station and bike monitors must not run at the same time: bike IMD pauses during CableCheck / station isolation test

dc_charge_choice.reason: meets 10-80% in about 20 min (T6 target) at 2C, a 40% of the 30 A datasheet maximum; lowest cell stress that hits the target; heat about 2 kW avg
dc_charge_choice.caveat: P60B datasheet does not state cycle life at 2C fast charge, and the charge chart is at 25 degC. Cold-weather derate and life are open until cell test data exists.

heat_notes.comment: the pack is the largest electrical heat source: pass these to the cooling agent

interconnect_mass_kg.basis: estimate: Al plates 0.8 mm per parallel group, 20 g series links; Al wire 0.4 mm x 3 mm is about 1 mg each, 2,200 bonds (negligible)
